final: WITH group_stats AS (SELECT o.timespan, AVG(1.0 * f.rebrate / NULLIF(f.feerate, 0)) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS fee_count FROM fees AS f JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.timespan), threshold AS (SELECT AVG(fee_count) AS avg_count FROM group_stats) SELECT AVG(g.avg_ratio), SUM(g.fee_count), AVG(g.fee_count - t.avg_count) FROM group_stats AS g CROSS JOIN threshold AS t WHERE g.fee_count > t.avg_count
